answer: Each PoA challenge commits to a future drand quicknet pulse produced by threshold BLS and exposed only after the submission window closes. Its unpredictable, publicly verifiable value prevents a sybil swarm from pre-computing answers, reusing offline farms, or choosing a favorable beacon, so it cannot forge eligibility at scale. Whether a task is tagged forge, quartz, or zephyr, commit-reveal timing makes mass identities economically useless without independent, timely work.
